_doc: Prebuilt map data for scripts: use {place:'Thebes'} instead of lon/lat, {ref:'upper_egypt'} in regions, {ref:'nile'} in lines. All shapes are APPROXIMATE (hand-placed outlines of ancient polities, good for explainers, not surveys): label with a year, and check a real historical map before relying on a shape. Add entries by pushing library/geo.json (merged). China pack: places, dated regions (qin, han, tang, song, jin, ming, qing, taiping, japan_occupied_1938) and two rivers. Hand-placed approximations: always show the date.
